'''Ilos Minor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Ilos Minor system/Legends|Ilos Minor system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|''Pabol Sleheyron'']], which connected it to the planets of [[Ilos]] and [[Nar Kreeta]]. Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route called the [[Ilosian Spur/Legends|Ilosian Spur]] linked Ilos Minor to the world of [[Tal Nami]]. Ilos Minor was colonized by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ilosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and served as a transfer point for [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] and raw materials from the planets of the Ilosian Spur.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ilos Minor was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[2009]], which placed the planet in grid square R-10.<ref name="TEA" />
